Kerala Vlogger Recounts Arrest by Afghan Authorities

A travel vlogger from Kerala, India, has recounted an ordeal involving her arrest by Afghan authorities in Bamyan. She stated that 'Mujahideen arrested me' and described the experience as an ordeal. The vlogger also indicated that being a woman was a factor in her treatment, saying, 'I Had to Go Through All This Because I Am A Woman.' Specific details regarding the duration of her detention or the exact charges, if any, were not provided in the coverage.
